# Overview: the seat table behind the Cortes hemicycle.
# One dot is 4 seats. spain_cortes_refresh_display writes the cumulative bloc totals,
# then this decides which frame each dot shows. Frames are 1-based, as the strip registered in
# interface/endsieg_spain_icons.gfx is: frame 1 is the neutral seat and frames 2..8 are the
# parties in chamber order, so a chamber with no seat table yet draws empty benches instead of
# a party colour.
# Generated by tools/build_spain_cortes_hemicycle.py.
#
# Dot order runs left to right around the chamber, so a cumulative total is the point
# on the semicircle where that bloc's seats end: a bloc owns every dot whose middle
# seat falls at or below its running total.
spain_cortes_draw_hemicycle = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = spain_cortes_cum_falange }

		set_variable = { var = spain_cortes_seat_1 value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = spain_cortes_cum_socialists value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { var = spain_cortes_seat_1 value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = spain_cortes_cum_republicans value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			set_variable = { var = spain_cortes_seat_1 value = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = spain_cortes_cum_liberals value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }

		}

		}
